args: set -e; echo M22_BEGIN; for p in com.cooper.lithic.debug com.cooper.lithic.debug.test; do echo PACKAGE=$p; f=$(pm path "$p"); echo "$f"; test "$(echo "$f" | wc -l)" -eq 1; sha256sum "${f#package:}"; dumpsys package "$p" | grep -E 'userId=|appId=|versionCode=|versionName=|User 0:'; done; echo M22_END
